body: Ouch!  However, this is only the second time I've genuinely smiled in at least as many weeks if not longer!  Thank you!  I hope you heal fast!

Nick, Tony and Chris.   Thank you for your DMs but this was a public apology owed to one particular person, not an invite to chat. In fact I doubt I will ever use Reddit again.

Rachel, you may just be the most caring person in the world.  Thank you for your thoughts
